files.name: dochi_cobblemon_editor-0.2.4-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.2.4 Change Log

  • Added Battle Presentation support during battles.
  • Added Pokémon rotation in the Cobblemon configuration screen.
  • Added compatibility with Cobblemon 1.8.2.
  • Added the Battle Scheduler Editor to manage field battles and integrate Scene Maker with Battle Presentation.
